meanings: again; once more; re-, second; another, then (after sth, and not until then), no matter how ... (followed by an adjective or verb, and then (usually) 也 or 都 for emphasis)
to exist; to be alive, (of sb or sth) to be (located) at, (used before a verb to indicate an action in progress)

early, morning, Good morning!, long ago, prematurely
how?, what?, why?, variant of 怎么
station, to stand, to halt, to stop, branch of a company or organization, website
